Batch scrape with empty batch_urls array returns error

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
begin
  engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(nil)
  urls = []
  result = Crawlberg.batch_scrape(engine, urls)
rescue StandardError => error
  warn "#{error.class}: #{error.message}"
end
```
